source.test_access_policy: validation selection was committed first; a schema/overlap preflight parsed the test rows but computed no model metrics; perform one fixed evaluation and never tune or repeat

selection.per_run: minimum validation NLL checkpoint, fixed before publisher-test access
selection.cross_candidate_baseline: lowest validation NLL across the four predeclared candidates

limits: This is one synthetic Japanese text task, not multimodal or broad Decision quality.
The official publisher test is not a sealed audit and its labels are not blind after the one-shot run.
Official train/test num values collide because the field is file-local; text-content hashes, not cross-file num values, are used for identity checks.
The official test reuses template_num groups from both train and validation, so it is not an unseen-template evaluation.
The Tohoku BERT-base projected four-tower estimate exceeds the provisional 200M parameter target.
No product promotion or 95-98 percent quality claim follows from this experiment.
